decision: 5 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 7 for the 12 month period).
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. The Stewards considered that Gasly was ahead at the apex of Turn 16 and was entitled to the line at the exit before Turn 17. Stroll attempted to keep the line and as a result had to drive off the circuit approaching the apex of Turn 17 which has a significant sausage kerb. Stroll re-entered the circuit at an angle that caused him to collide with Gasly.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
